'''House Demain''' is one of the known [[Nobility|noble]] [[House]]s of [[Kandor]].

Lady [[Ines Demain]] is a member of the House. Her husband was a soldier who fought in the [[Aiel War]]. At the war's end, she gave birth to [[Rahien Demain]] near [[Dragonmount]] the day after [[Gitara Moroso]]'s [[Foretelling]] that the Dragon would be reborn. As such, [[Moiraine Damodred]] suspected that Rahien may have been the Dragon Reborn, although this proved to be false. After the war, Ines's husband passed away, and she went into seclusion at the [[Aesdaishar Palace]].
